values: Open jobs by who they are waiting on
=IFERROR(QUERY(Jobs!A:V,"select H,A,D,G,J,K,I where F='active' order by H,K",1),"No open jobs")
=IFERROR(QUERY(Jobs!A:V,"select A,D,J,K,H where F='active' and K <> '' and K < '"&TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd")&"' order by K",1),"Nothing overdue")

=IFERROR(QUERY(Credits!A:N,"select C, sum(F) where D starts with '"&TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm")&"' and (N = 'credits' or N = '' or N is null) group by C label sum(F) 'credits'",1),"No credits this month")
=IFERROR(QUERY(Jobs!A:V,"select J, count(A) where F='active' group by J label count(A) 'open jobs'",1),"No open jobs")

=IFERROR(QUERY(BriefQuestions!A:L,"select A,C,E,I where J='open' and I <> '' and I < '"&TEXT(NOW()-IFERROR(VLOOKUP("client_question_reminder_hours",Config!A:B,2,FALSE),24)/24,"yyyy-mm-dd")&"T"&TEXT(NOW()-IFERROR(VLOOKUP("client_question_reminder_hours",Config!A:B,2,FALSE),24)/24,"HH:mm:ss")&"+05:30' order by I",1),"No client replies pending")
